pages.title: Survival and scouting
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Armor$(): extra protection; usage 20 per piece.$(li)$(item)Nightvision$(): helmet; usage 20.$(li)$(item)Scramble$(): helmet; usage 50. Helps avoid sentinels.$(li)$(item)Regeneration$(): chestplate; usage 40.$(li)$(item)Forcefield$(): chestplate; usage 80. Blocks projectiles and reduces other damage.

pages.title: Movement
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Flight$(): chestplate; usage 30. Hold Jump for upward thrust.$(li)$(item)Hover$(): chestplate; usage 10. Holds altitude with Flight; sneak to descend.$(li)$(item)Speed$(): leggings; usage 20.$(li)$(item)Featherfalling$(): boots; usage 20. Prevents fall damage while working.$(li)$(item)Step Assist$(): boots; usage 10. Steps over taller obstacles.

pages.title: Plan your loadout
pages.text: Flight, Hover and Regeneration together use 80 on the chestplate. Adding Forcefield would exceed even an Energy-assisted budget; choose which abilities to run.$(br2)Some modules are found as equipment loot rather than made from blueprints. Check your available patterns before planning an upgrade.$(br2)Keep spare fuel for the return journey.
